shadows.name: rose-lg
shadows.purpose: Existing primary button and expanded logo elevation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing primary action; use the Button primitive in the app.
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 2.25rem; font: 500 0.875rem var(--font-sans); box-shadow: var(--shadow-rose-lg); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary navigation and actions use the existing outline variant.
components.css: .ds-outline { background: var(--sidebar); color: var(--secondary-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 2.25rem; font: 500 0.875rem var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); border-color: var(--ring); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Existing bordered, rounded text field with visible focus and error states.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 400 0.875rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--input); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--destructive); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Peer task destinations with a single active item; the app uses Sidebar primitives.
components.html: Meal planLog
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; background: var(--sidebar); font: 500 0.875rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); border-radius: var(--radius-md); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring); }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 0.75rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-badge:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Existing rounded surface for grouped content, not a replacement page scaffold.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); }

narrative.overview: Preserve the incumbent visual identity: rose accents, light canvas, slate text, rounded controls, Quicksand headings, and Geist body text.
dos: Reuse existing components and their state variants.
Use semantic color and spacing tokens.
donts: Do not introduce one-off colors or fonts.
